contract: The media.remote_execution scope authorizes a direct peer to submit, inspect and cancel bounded self-contained image generation jobs through signed one-time PeerStore envelopes. The receiving runtime admits work only to its canonical durable MediaJobs queue and returns bounded job state and artifact references; it never reports provider or model success at admission. The requesting runtime retains idempotent peer/job provenance in a remote_media_executions table inside the canonical jobs.sqlite3 database. Request IDs replay consistently, incompatible reuse conflicts, state revisions guard cancellation, and private peer identity or artifact bytes never enter the protocol.
acceptance: Use two real PeerStore homes and an actual loopback HTTP server to prove signed cross-runtime queue admission into the receiver's canonical MediaJobs database, durable requester provenance, replay and status/cancel operations.
Deny outbound and inbound media.remote_execution independently, reject wrong or replayed proofs, and prove rejected requests create no canonical media job.
Restrict this pre-asset-sharing slice to image_generate inputs containing prompt, size and numeric controls, with bounded request IDs, 16 KiB inputs and 32 KiB envelopes.
Project only bounded canonical job state and result artifact references. Queue admission remains distinct from real external inference and does not claim GPU, provider, model or artifact completion.
Expose authenticated owner HTTP, cryptographically authenticated federation HTTP, approval-gated native mutation tools and a console workflow over the same durable service.
limitations: Local qualification proves two loopback Gideon runtimes, signed policy and canonical queue admission. External inference, remote GPU availability and completed artifact production require separate provider-backed evidence.
Conditioning images, masks, LoRAs, video and dataset-backed operations require selective media transfer in platform.24 and are intentionally refused here.
Shared dashboard handler registration, exact federation auth middleware bypass, platform Page rendering and durability inventory enrollment remain root-owned integration hooks.
integration_hooks: Register capabilities_remote_media.register with one app-bound RemoteMedia created from the same canonical MediaJobs and bound PeerStore used by that dashboard application.

Add only POST /api/capabilities/platform/remote-media/federation/{action} to the shared dashboard token middleware exact bypass boundary; the handler still requires and consumes a valid PeerStore proof for media.remote_execution.
Render RemoteMedia.tsx from the shared platform Page and navigation.
Enroll the new remote_media_executions table with the existing capabilities/media/jobs.sqlite3 durability inventory; there is no second media job store.

qualification.stages: Compile, runtime and UI passed in the first continuation qualification gate.
